title: Structural Balance in Real-World Social Networks: Incorporating Direction and Transitivity in Measuring Partial Balance
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It introduces and tests a method for evaluating partial structural balance in signed directed social networks.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion or faith; therefore, there are no findings related to this topic.
